div.head: Conclusions
div.p: This paper has presented a simple hybrid EDF scheduler for the implementation of resource-constrained real-time embedded control systems. The paper has described how a schedulability analysis can be performed for the modified scheduler, which will have polynomial run-time complexity in most situations. Future work will evaluate the comparative performance of the hEDF scheduling algorithm in representative real-time control situations, and will extend the analysis to include multiple I/O tasks as in [9].
